title: Sensei Relay
look: Relay board: Flat assistant nodes on a grid, task cards gliding along live wires. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion.

scenes.name: In silos
scenes.desc: Many assistants sit on the board, each boxed in its own silo.

scenes.name: You relay
scenes.desc: The user ferries tasks and messages between assistants and every review is a self-review.

scenes.name: Register
scenes.desc: Sensei Relay: one assistant registers as controller, the rest as contributors, and wires connect them.

scenes.name: Plan and dispatch
scenes.desc: The controller plans the goal, sends task cards to contributors, and they report back.

scenes.name: Review and gate
scenes.desc: Contributors cross-review against the requirement; results consolidate and pass a metrics gate.

scenes.name: Always on
scenes.desc: Assistants unregister and rejoin, the controller hands over, then the Sensei Relay end card.
